name: Quinoa Chickpea Biryani
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: 1 bay leaf, 2 cardamom pods and 2 cloves
1 tsp biryani masala and ½ tsp chilli powder
Mint, coriander, lemon juice and salt
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil and brown the onion for 8 minutes with the whole spices.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomato, masala and chilli and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and soy yogurt and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the quinoa and ¾ cup water. Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Fluff and finish with mint, coriander and lemon.
note: A one-pot biryani; quinoa cooks quickly and keeps the dish light.
